method: Read-only Win32_Process descendant snapshots, runtime worker command-line classification and netstat -ano; 250 ms delay after each completed sample. IP addresses and command lines intentionally not retained.
limitations: Short-lived processes or sockets between samples may be missed.
The PC remains network-connected. Desktop private-LAN TLS receiver sockets are separate from inference worker sockets.
A process/socket observation alone is not full workflow acceptance or proof of enforced offline isolation.
